summary: Revise. G02–G05 pass and neither safety-critical criterion is zero, but G06 fails and the 2.1 average reflects bounded causal-order, liveness, election, proof-ledger, client, snapshot, fencing, diagnosis, and RFC gaps. The immutable evidence can remain unchanged while dated addenda address these omissions.
